method: Actual NoMergePolicy Writer, 24 append commits; selected segment file lengths before merge and newly published segment file lengths after merge; no timing sampling.

query_correctness.note: IDs and identity-request counts remain exact. These are competitive stored-identity requests, not all metadata reads, block decompressions, source I/O or total query setup work.

limits: Scaled floor reuses the production selector and actual segment sizes; no large-fleet physical-byte amplification bound.
Selected file lengths are logical merge inputs/outputs, not measured physical I/O.
File byte counts may vary slightly; regressions assert strict reduction rather than an exact byte golden.
Bottom-tier outputs can remerge without promotion; deletion cleanup uses document count, not deleted-byte weight.
A tier selects all eligible segments; merge fanout remains unbounded.
Unchanged sources can finish previously pending compaction.
